goal: Extract the Generate transaction (the On-demand generation door, #729 / map #710 item 3) out of the HTTP entry point into a named domain module that receives tx explicitly; the route stays the composition root. Behaviour-preserving.
non_goals: No Generate-specific auto-approval guard — D-H stands: invariant #3 protection is the whole typed chain; a duplicate guard would duplicate policy and could drift (map #710 forbids it)
No fix for the Generate/live-ingest stale-content race — #724/#728 own it
No changes to the regenerate lane or the legacy past-replies lanes
No schema change, no migration, no feature flag
No HTTP contract change: status codes, error strings, response bodies, and the existing NO_STORE_HEADERS asymmetry between pre-tx and in-tx refusals are preserved byte-for-byte
user_visible_behavior: None — behaviour-preserving refactor. POST /api/dashboard/reviews/[reviewId]/generate keeps its exact HTTP contract.
invariants: #2: enqueueGenerateResponse stays inside the same transaction as the review FOR UPDATE lock
#3: the enqueue pins originLane = ON_DEMAND_GENERATE and suppressNotification = true — both preserved, neither deleted (ticket #678 note in the route header)
#12: the route orchestrates only (auth, rate limits, ownership proof, sql.begin, result-to-HTTP mapping); the module owns the transaction's failure behaviour with focused tests
#15: the module receives tx: TransactionSql as an explicit parameter and never imports @/lib/db/server; the route remains the composition root

#8: the three sibling reads that today key on review_id alone become natively business-scoped (AND business_id = ...), so their three tenant-root-lookup allowlist entries are deleted (ALLOWLIST_BASELINE 412 -> 409)
TOCTOU: assertWritableSubscriptionForBusiness is re-asserted INSIDE the locked transaction, exactly as today
edge_cases: review vanishes between the ownership proof and the FOR UPDATE lock -> 404 review_not_found
non-terminal sibling exists -> 409 draft_already_exists with { response_id, status }
failed sibling with the post_after_delete_failed_ prefix (orphan) -> 409 orphan_recovery_pending
offboarding confirmed between the pre-tx check and the tx -> in-tx writable gate refuses with its own status/error
version allocation is COALESCE(MAX(version),0)+1 over ALL sibling rows including superseded (D-B: never hardcoded 1)
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/shared/writable-subscription.ts — typed result union { ok: true } | { ok: false; status; error }
src/lib/reviews/process-review.ts — nearest tx-receiving review-domain module (the live-ingest cousin of this door)
src/lib/reviews/import-consent.ts — module owning a guarded enqueue with an explicit tx parameter
src/app/api/dashboard/reviews/[reviewId]/generate/__tests__/route.test.ts + generate-version.integration.test.ts — the characterization eval; they must stay green, ideally unchanged
tests_to_add: locks the review row before any sibling read and returns review_not_found when the lock finds no row
re-asserts the business-scoped writable gate inside the locked transaction and passes its refusal through unchanged
returns already_answered when a posted sibling exists
returns draft_already_exists with the newest non-terminal sibling id and status
returns orphan_recovery_pending when a failed sibling carries the post_after_delete_failed_ prefix
returns regenerate_in_progress when an in-flight generate_response outbox row exists
allocates version as COALESCE(MAX(version),0)+1 and never hardcodes 1
enqueues via enqueueGenerateResponse with originLane ON_DEMAND_GENERATE and suppressNotification true in the same transaction
every sibling read is scoped by business_id as well as review_id
estimated_prod_lines: 200 (route -~120, module +~150, allowlist -24 + baseline bump; net roughly flat-to-negative)
estimated_test_lines: 350 (one new module-focused unit suite; the two existing characterization suites stay untouched)
rollback_plan: git revert of the squash-merge — no migration, no flag, no data-shape change.
observability: on_demand_generate_enqueued structured log line (createWorkerLogger('[OnDemandGenerate]')) preserved with the same fields; it moves to the route AFTER sql.begin resolves, so it now fires post-commit instead of pre-commit inside the tx — a deliberate truthfulness improvement, recorded here
reportCaughtError('reviews/generate', ...) Sentry path preserved for the 500 mapping
